entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Apologies for suddenly disappearing[n]like that.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: The Legend of the Lost Inari[n]has come to an end!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Where the hell were you?[n]Did you seriously get lost?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I saw a man who resembled[n]Dr. Maruki, so I went to see him.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So he was there?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Did you go to his counseling?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes. It was... certainly not what[n]I was expecting.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Once this is all over, I think I'd[n]like to go to another session.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Try not to cause him any[n]trouble, all right?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'll do my best. Are you all[n]at home?
Yeah.
I'm at home.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Are you still at school, Yusuke?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: No, I just got back to the dorm.[n]I'm getting ready for bed.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Already?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Is that unusual? Tomorrow is[n]Akechi-kun's panel, after all.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: An early night means he'll be[n]able to concentrate tomorrow.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's true. We'll need to stay[n]focused tomorrow.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We have to stay calm, no matter[n]what he says.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Right. I'll keep that in mind.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's really up to Makoto to get as much[n]information as we can from Akechi...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We'll have to make sure we don't[n]miss anything.
